spark.scene: True-color view of the Hawaiian Island chain with scattered small white trade cumulus north and south. Two diffuse gray haze veils are visible leeward over the ocean, the largest and densest west to southwest of the southeastern large island and a fainter elongated veil west of the central islands.

classify.caveats: Segmentation upwind ends are offshore and approximate; wind varies locally and with height. FIRMS counts are rendered marker pixels, not individual detections. Summit thermal glow (45 px at Kilauea) is excluded and not used as eruption proof. Plume 1 upwind is ~70-85 km from summits and >85 km from nearest listed fire pixels, so exact fire of origin cannot be isolated from this context alone.
